entries.title: Your panels' buttons and cards on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: A panel's own buttons now show in its title row on the Panels tab, and they work as they do on your computer. A card a panel puts up shows on Home after your other cards, with its own buttons, and Hide takes it away. When a panel opens a task, your iPhone or iPad opens that task too.

picture.alt: The phone's Home with a panel's card titled Tally note, the word yours, its note and an Open the record button, and a minus button to hide it at its right.
